prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Delay Sign In After Pet Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and photo upload so users choose their pet before creating or logging into an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Check Screen: Add a new desktop preview screen during adoption to verify pet rendering on the user's desktop screen before proceeding.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_desktop_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"hint": "Next, verify how your pet looks on your desktop screen."}}
2: [finish, redesign] Home Desktop Controls Quickstart Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a split visual layout highlighting essential desktop controls for summoning, dragging, and hiding the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Learn quick shortcuts to interact with, move, or hide your companion anytime.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "home_welcome", "label": "Desktop Gestures & Controls", "style": "rounded"}]}}}
3: [home, new_flow] Wait Time Progress and Activity Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive multi-step preview flow with estimated completion time, progress status, and pet tip carousel.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Pet Assets", "body": "We are generating your desktop pet animations. Relax or set a system alert!", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "text": "Tip: You can drag your pet across multi-monitor setups anytime."}]}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Restore Clarification Notice: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores missing pets and syncs accounts safely.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pets", "body": "Sign in with your existing account to prevent pet resets and keep your desktop companions safe."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Guidance Hint: Add explicit formatting and lighting guidance hints on the upload photos screen to ensure successful custom pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with a single centered subject."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Notification Toggle: Add a desktop ready notification toggle and delay tip to the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you when your pet is ready!"}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Compact Layout Restructure: Switch choose_path to a compact layout with step counters to reduce visual clutter and decision fatigue.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "compact", "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Select Your Adoption Journey", "body": "Choose standard adoption or create a custom pet companion."}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Path Selection Starter Trait Banner: Add a playful mascot banner component on choose_path encouraging users to pick a path to unlock companion traits.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Select a path to unlock unique desktop behaviors for your pet!"}]}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Shortcut Tray Notification: Show a taskbar tray notification hint on home_intro when onboarding finishes.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Your pet is now live! Access quick controls anytime from your system taskbar tray."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under rule 4.
Adding a desktop preview screen within onboarding is permitted by rule 4.
Redesigning home_intro layout and components inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4.
Adding wait time progress, completion estimates, and tip carousel to the waiting screen is permitted by rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy to clarify account sync does not violate any base rules.
Adding photo formatting and lighting hints to the upload screen is allowed under rule 4.
Adding background notification toggles and delay hints to the waiting screen is permitted by rule 4.
Restructuring choose_path into a compact layout with step counters is allowed under rule 4.
Adding a playful mascot banner component on choose_path is permitted and does not violate copy or pricing rules.
Adding a system taskbar tray notification hint to home_intro is allowed under rule 4.
